_comment: Polished nephrite jade: a felted mass of fine amphibole fibres, polished to a soft, waxy lustre; a medium leaf-green, cloudy rather than banded, with paler and deeper green clouds, a faint fibrous streak and the odd black speck. SUBSURFACE: jade's look is light getting into it, a few millimetres, green travelling furthest. subsurface_color is ONE constant, the texture's mean linear albedo (the library cannot drive a textured article's scatter colour from its texture), so at subsurface_weight 0.6 the clouds keep about 40 % of their contrast. Base textures are generated (L2, tools/converters/base/gen_nephritejade_polished.py), as the wish list plans: ambientCG has no jade asset. Carries every relevant wear layer at 0 (C1): scratches (overlay 1, damage), dust as a deposit (Phase10), water spots, gated by the Crevice mask. Built by the Phase11 batch.
name: NephriteJade_Polished_Clean_Base_s01_v01

sources.why: Mean linear albedo (0.055, 0.14, 0.065), about sRGB 66, 105, 72, for a medium-green nephrite; roughness about 0.14 for jade's waxy polish; specular_ior 1.61 (nephrite about 1.60-1.63); subsurface_weight 0.6, subsurface_color the mean albedo, subsurface_radius 0.004 m with green travelling furthest (0.45, 1.0, 0.55): jade is translucent a few millimetres in. Physically Based has no jade entry.
